Cryostat Control
===================================================

**device name: cryostat_control**

The cryostat control object allows you to execute system-wide operations like evacuating the cryostat, cooling it down, warming it up, or venting the dewar.
It also collects and analyzes metrics, indicating the overall state of the system. These values include the status of the pre-cooling unit, its temperature, and the dewar pressure.
